summary: NeoGenomics filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a $316.25M offering of 0.75% Convertible Senior Notes due 2032. The notes were priced at a 35% conversion premium over the $10.49 reference stock price ($14.16 conversion price). The notes are senior unsecured obligations, maturing July 1, 2032, with semiannual interest and customary covenants. Holders may convert before April 1, 2032 under specified circumstances; settlement may be in cash, stock, or a combination. The offering was upsized from $275M initial to $316.25M via greenshoe. Watch for dilution risk at conversion or any early repurchase provisions.
